Guides

How to move your files to a new computer without losing anything

Getting a new computer is exciting until you remember everything on the old one. Here is a safe way to move across.

1. Make a list. Write down what matters: documents, photos, email, browser bookmarks, and programs you use.

2. Back up first. Copy your important files to an external drive or a cloud service before you touch anything. A backup protects you if something goes wrong.

3. Find your files. Look in Documents, Desktop, Downloads, Pictures and any other folders you use. Do not forget files stored in odd places.

4. Check your logins. Make sure you know your email, Microsoft or Apple account, and any passwords you will need on the new computer.

5. Move the files. You can use an external drive, a cloud account or a direct cable transfer. Large photo and video collections are best moved with a drive.

6. Reinstall your programs. Programs cannot just be copied. Download or reinstall them, and sign in again. Check you have licence keys for paid software.

7. Check before you wipe. Open a few files on the new computer. Only after you are sure everything is there should you erase the old one.

8. Keep a backup going. Turn on a regular backup so your new computer is protected from day one.
